Claims remain bounded to official Texas record-location, query, mapping, well-file, state-land, and unclaimed-property logistics. Each source role preserves the agency limits and is not converted into ownership, status, payment, entitlement, or value proof.

The article invents no owner, tract, acreage, decimal, lease, well, production, payment, suspense, shut-in, title, economic, valuation, or offer fact and supplies no universal numerical assumption or result.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, oil and gas production data (accessed 2026-08-23)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Railroad Commission production-data page identifies official Texas production-query channels and describes the data as production information reported by operators.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only to log a query date, located lease or well reference, reported period, and evidence location; it does not infer private ownership, payment entitlement, current operating status, or value.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Public GIS Viewer (accessed 2026-08-23)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Railroad Commission GIS page describes survey, lease, API, well, and mapping search features and warns that viewer information has no legal force or effect.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only to locate and preserve record identifiers and the query date; it does not treat a map result as authoritative location, title, status, entitlement, or value evidence.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, oil and gas well records (accessed 2026-08-23)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Railroad Commission well-records page describes available well-file channels and the identifiers useful when requesting records.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only to log a request, request date, identifiers supplied, and response location; it does not interpret the contents of a well file.

sources_inspected.label: Texas General Land Office, energy and mapping resources (accessed 2026-08-23)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Texas General Land Office energy page identifies state-land, lease, scanned-record, and mapping resources.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the page only to locate a state-land or state-lease record reference when applicable; it does not construe a state record or decide ownership or lease rights.

sources_inspected.label: Texas Comptroller, Texas Unclaimed Property (accessed 2026-08-23)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: Texas Unclaimed Property provides the official state search and claim-status channel.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the site only to log the searched name, date, result or claim reference, holder name, and follow-up owner; it does not treat a result as proof of mineral ownership, suspense, entitlement, or payable funds.
